title: Senior Director, Data Center Operations
description:
**PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS POSITION IS LOCATED IN SALINE, MI**

  

**About the business**

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for enterprises as a diverse team of creators and inventors. We operate with the speed and attitude of a start\-up, combined with the scale and customer focus of one of the world's leading enterprise technology companies.


As OCI continues to expand its cloud and AI infrastructure footprint, the scale and complexity of our data center operations are increasing significantly. We are looking for an exceptional operations leader to build and lead the operating model required to support this growth across one of our large north America data center sites. This position will build and lead an organization of approximately 250 people


  
* Own and lead large\-scale data center operations across one of Oracle's North America 'Go Big' sites, spanning deployment and ongoing production operations.
* Build the operating model, systems, processes, and organizational capabilities required to run an increasingly large and complex data center footprint.
* Create a highly scalable operations environment where growth is enabled through better systems, automation, processes, tooling, and operating mechanisms \- not simply through incremental headcount.
* Establish operating mechanisms that improve throughput, productivity, quality, reliability, and speed across the organization.
* Oversee technician organizations responsible for hardware deployment, break/fix activities, GPU rack installation, compute infrastructure connectivity, and customer deployment.
* Develop and drive the NPI process strategy, ensuring new infrastructure products, technologies, and deployment models can be introduced consistently and at scale.
* Establish world\-class spare parts and inventory management capabilities that ensure required hardware is available where and when it is needed without creating unnecessary operational cost or complexity.
